description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

In-Depth Engineering Corporation seeks junior or mid-level software engineers to support Department of the Navy development and modernization programs. The role maintains and updates the AEGIS Combat System’s Display Subsystem, including investigating, implementing, testing, and integrating software fixes.
Software engineer developing and integrating object-oriented C++/Java for defense display subsystems, including testing and design documentation

Responsibilities:
• Prepare Software Engineering design documentation
• Utilize modern software development tools in an agile environment to design, develop, integrate, and test software solutions for the Aegis Display Subsystem
• Develop object-oriented C++ and Java code in a Linux environment
• Prepare and present engineering material within the peer review process and to customer as appropriate
• Travel to the customer site to perform investigation, testing, or integration of software fixes

Requirements:
• Candidates for consideration must be a US citizen and hold an active Department of Defense secret clearance
• BS or MS in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
• 1+ years of experience
• Must have 1+ years of experience with C++ in a professional setting
